nodes.label: White-label / DRY Design
nodes.rationale: Brand, cart key, order prefix, admin auth cookie centralized in packages/site-config/src/brand.ts; money formatting via shared formatInr; API client via @linq/secure-api; seed catalog is bootstrap-only so live catalog stays in Prisma via API — avoids duplicating brand/money/client logic across storefront and admin apps.

nodes.label: Admin Auth Feature
nodes.rationale: JWT in httpOnly cookie (brand.adminAuthCookie) with @StaffAuth() guarding admin write/list routes while product/category reads and order creation stay public; bootstrap admin from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars for initial setup without manual DB seeding.

nodes.label: Identity Split: User (staff) vs Customer (shopper)
nodes.rationale: User (core) holds passwordHash for admin/staff login while Customer (meta) is the storefront buyer owning addresses, carts, orders and reviews — separating system/staff identity from transactional shopper identity across schemas.
